rom_sha256_status: Matches the cartridge, all six suites, independent smoke and all ten focused reports.
human_approval: No v0.22.0 human approval recorded; single combined playtest pending.
media_status: Current focused native captures/audio from this cartridge. GIF playback timing is approximate.

features.title: Animation with weight
features.description: Planted breathing and steps, strong-attack anticipation, landing release and get-up transitions reuse each fighter's approved poses.
try: Walk forward and back, then jump and land with Damian or Reston.
Use X or A, then earn a throw or sweep knockdown and watch the recovery.

features.title: Readable hits and blocks
features.description: Light hits use compact amber sparks, strong hits larger gold bursts, and blocks hollow cyan braces, with distinct freeze and camera response.
try: Compare a close Y hit with an X hit.
Hold away or Down+away with the defender and compare block feedback.

features.title: Four normals with distinct roles
features.description: Y is the quick close jab, X the committed heavy punch, B the spacing/low kick and A the longest normal with its retained air cross-up.

media.label: Lars light kick at its front reach

try: Confirm Y into X or B into A on a real hit; try a close jab after blocking a heavy.
Compare B at its tip with a close Down+B, then jump past and press A.

features.title: Individual fighter gestures
features.description: All twelve fighters have individual intro gestures and winner sequences, with signature accents drawn from existing native effects.
try: Watch an opening with Damian, then choose another fighter.
Earn a round win and compare the winner's sequence with the opening gesture.

features.title: Training history and drills
features.description: A live footer records five commands, current/last combo hits and damage, plus SP! for accepted ordinary specials. Training guide page 3 adds three drills.

media.label: Recorded P1 motion history and status footer

try: In Training, pause and press Select three times: Up toggles the display; Down changes the drill.
Try Normal -> Special, Block a Low Attack or Air Kick Cross-up; live P1 Select resets progress and keeps your choices.

features.title: CPU fighting personalities
features.description: Each CPU has individual spacing, pressure, guard, throw and recovery-answer habits. Normal/Hard can attempt fair full-gauge supers after defense.

media.label: Cristian CPU attack guarded by the player

try: Choose CPU on Training's ordinary PAUSED card and use either pad's L/R shoulders to set a level.
Compare Cristobal's pressure with Ivo's retreat or David's recovery answers at the same difficulty.

features.title: Twelve full-gauge supers
features.description: Fresh neutral Y+B spends all 96 energy on an individual volley, rush or rising sequence. Startup is vulnerable and recovery is committed.

media.label: Native move list with super command and names

try: Wait for full energy and your projectile to finish; release directions and both buttons, then press Y+B together while grounded and free to act.
Compare Damian's volley with Cristobal's rush or David's rising finish; try guarding or interrupting a super.

features.title: Stage depth and ambient reactions
features.description: Distant and nearer scenery bands shift subtly above a fixed floor. Refreshed ambient cells give real round winners two short cheers and settle to neutral.

media.label: Las Condes band scroll above a fixed floor

try: Walk both fighters together left and right across each arena without attacking.
Earn a round win and watch the ambient reaction; pause to freeze the scene.

features.title: Personal Arcade exchanges and endings
features.description: Two-speaker openings include six reciprocal rivalries, followed by individual winner quotes and personal text beside the retained champion trophy.
try: Play Arcade with Damian/Reston or Ivo/Cote; wait about six seconds or press P1 A to skip the exchange.
Defeat all eleven opponents for a personal ending; Continue retries the same opponent after a loss.

features.title: Resident sound and announcements
features.description: Distinct light/strong/guard sounds, menu/round and victory chords, spoken Round/Fight/K O and music ducking accompany the five retained original scores.

media.label: Native round opening: score, speech and ducking
Native complete KO and victory cue mix

try: Listen to a round opening and compare light, heavy and guarded contact.
Earn a KO and hear the spoken cue, music recovery and victory cadence; healthy timeouts do not announce KO.
